idea-plugin.name: WhatIsThis
idea-plugin.description:
WhatIsThis — select anything, press one shortcut, get an instant answer about what it is.

选中任何东西，一键发问，瞬间告诉你“这是干嘛的”。

  • 📸 Screenshot / 截图：clipboard image → what is this button / UI control / code snippet / error message?
  • 💻 Code selection / 选中代码：what it does, syntax sugar used, and its likely role in your project.
  • 📄 File / 文件：right-click any file in the editor or Project View and ask.
  • ⚡ Built for speed: single streaming API call, concise ≤200-character answers, follow-up questions in the same popup.
  • 🔑 Bring your own key: DeepSeek, Doubao Ark, Zhipu GLM, Moonshot Kimi, Alibaba Qwen, OpenAI, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Keys are stored in the IDE PasswordSafe.

Privacy: screenshots and code you ask about are sent to the LLM provider you configure yourself. 截图与代码将发送至你自行配置的大模型服务商。
